title: url bug with search state change
body:
![screen capture on 2017-01-04 at 19-47-55](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/2003834/21641482/0f20e58c-d2b7-11e6-90da-0682295fee6f.gif)

I followed this guide:
https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/guide/Routing.html
and set up the example.
As you see, the first refinementList[colors] didn't disappear, but the second and the third disappeared.

And is there a way to rename the state to shorten the url, such as "refinementList"is too long.

comments.body:
@mthuret 
Thanks, it's solved.
 And is there a way to rename the state to shorten the url?
ex: 
refinementList => dFR
query => q

That's nice to hear @terranboy :). 

If you want to shorten the url, you will have to code that function yourself (like you added the cleanup for empty values).

We might add an utility for this in the future, but nothing is planned yet.
